events.title: Activism 101
events.description: It's easy to feel overwhelmed if you want to change things for better in the world. events.title: Agatha Christie - 50th Anniversary of Her Death
events.description: Half a century since Christie died, and Poirot remains the most filmed fictional detective in history. A look at her enduring legacy, the current adaptation boom, what makes her plots genuinely uncrackable, and why nobody ever suspects the right person. Additional Panelists: Bill Hussar, Heather Stephenson(Moderator), Janne McKamey

events.title: Age Is Just a Number: Older Protagonists in UF
events.description: Our panel of Authors discusses their use of protagonists older than the average age typically seen in much of the genre. Additional Panelists: Anna Puerta(Moderator)

events.title: Are You Smarter than a '90s Kid? - Cartoon Game Show (P1)
events.description: Hang on to your diapies, babies – we're going in for another round of this Fan-favorite game show featuring the crème de la crème of '90s and early '00s cartoons! Come test your knowledge and take a stroll down Memory Lane! Additional Panelists: Rhonda Bell

events.title: Away Team Scavenger Hunt – Debrief & Awards
events.description: Mission Complete! Meet here for a debriefing where your discoveries will be catalogued, and prizes will be beamed into the hands of the top Teams! Additional Panelists: Lucy Boydston(Judge)

events.title: B5's John Sheridan: Captain, Commander, & President
events.description: When Sinclair left Babylon 5 on his diplomatic mission, a new era dawned under the command of John Sheridan. What changes did he make to the flow of the station—and the show? What was his role and influence as a character? Let's dive into the Shadows and illuminate his impact on the series. Additional Panelists: Gary Lindros, Karen Henson(Moderator), Laura J. Schroeder

events.title: Batman & Daredevil: The Dark Knight & Man without Fear
events.description: Batman & Daredevil are both driven to rid their world of evil. Both find their origins rooted in extreme grief that pushed them to be the best so others don't have to experience that level of pain. What else do these heroes have in common, and what is unique to them individually? Additional Panelists: Tony Barletta(Moderator)

events.title: Battle of the Bodies: Bodies in Motion
events.description: 'Show it, don't say it,' Makes a ton of sense until it's time to actually put characters into physical motion while interacting with other bodies in motion. It gets even trickier when you must have the positioning make sense. Just how bendy? How long is too long when it comes to legs or girth?

events.title: Battle of the Tropes: YA Edition
events.description: Friends to lovers, or enemies to lovers? The Chosen One, or the Underdog? Come join us with some of our wonderful YA authors as we discuss our favorite tropes and debate the merits of each. Which trope will come out on top? Additional Panelists: Marianne Danneman(Moderator)

events.title: Battlestar Galactica: A Galaxy of Stars
events.description: The Colonial Fleet is in, and they're ready for your questions! Meet the stars of Battlestar Galactica as they arrive at Dragon Con 2026 for a Q&A that is out of this world.

events.title: Character Encounter StoryTime
events.description: Gather 'round for children's stories read by character performers. Intended for children under 9. Kids under 16 must be with a parent/guardian; children 7+ must have badges. Adults without kids may be turned away.

events.title: Cover Art: Making the Best First Impression

What makes a cover great? We discuss that with some of the best Artists in the business. Additional Panelists: Ariel Colon, Benno Rothschild(Moderator)

events.title: Cryptid Throwdown!

events.title: Do It Anyway: Making a Motion Simulator from Scrap

events.title: Done Is Better than Perfect: Thawing Your Creative Freeze
events.description: You've edited it a hundred times – and still haven't hit publish. Perfectionism and imposter syndrome are stealing your voice. Let it go! Done is better than perfect. Join us to learn how to quiet the perfectionism noise and finally hit publish.

events.title: Editing the Eerie: Curating Horror Anthologies

events.description: If you want to get more historically accurate or even craft a top-tier look, you'll need more supplies than what you can find in craft stores. events.title: FTL Downsides: Science of Traveling Faster than Light
events.description: TV and movies often make faster-than-light travel look like a convenient way to travel around the universe – but even if we managed to find a way to do it, you probably wouldn't want to...at least, not once you learn about all the downsides. Additional Panelists: Jack Strange(Moderator)

events.title: Fallout: Season 2 Fan Discussion
events.description: Fallout Fans unite as Season 2 cracks open new vault mysteries, twisted factions, & that signature campy wasteland humor! events.title: Finding Your Way Online: Content Creation, YouTube Distribution, & More

events.title: The Evolution of D&D Mechanics
events.description: We take a retrospective look at how Dungeons & Dragons came to be! How did the early game arrive at its ruleset? Why did they settle on Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence...etc? Where do hit points come from? Spell slots? We talk to people who were there from the beginning! Additional Panelists: Rush Lilavivat(Moderator)

events.title: The Golden Age of OAVs
events.description: Explore the golden age of Japanese animated direct-to-video works from the early '80s to the early 2000s. We'll examine how the OVA format shaped Anime in Japan and the US, highlighting influential titles through clips, visuals, and discussion. Additional Panelists: Darius Washington

events.title: The Woman in White: Why Every Culture Has a Ghost She Can't Forget
events.description: Ghostly women in white appear in legends worldwide – from La Llorona to y?rei, banshees, Victorian spirits, and modern roadside phantoms. Explore why this haunting figure endures and what these stories reveal about grief, gender, trauma, and cultural fears.

events.title: The World of Monster High: The Movies, the Shows, the Dolls, & More
events.description: Fans of all ages can join in a discussion of different aspects of the Monster High world, and what makes our favorite ghouls special. Additional Panelists: Austinn West, Carol Malcolm(Moderator), Gabby, Gracie Palmer (Virtual), Vikki Ortone

events.title: Thieves' World
events.description: Thieves' World is a classic shared-world Fantasy book series, originally a collection of anthologies edited by Robert Lynn Asprin and Lynn Abbey, set in the gritty, lawless city of Sanctuary. It pioneered the concept of multiple authors writing stories within the same universe.

events.title: Unsung Heroes & Swiss-Army Actors in Stargate
events.description: Marquee heroes get our attention (and are here at the Con!). But, what about all the background characters giving their all, and the ones that show up in multiple roles across the Stargate franchises? Let's talk about some of our favorite characters/actors who deserve more time in the spotlight. Additional Panelists: Alli Martin, Callie Kelley, Joe Campbell, Karen Henson(Moderator), Lacee Aderhold

events.title: Warp for Real: Experimental Spacetime Distortion and Gravity Engineering
events.description: Can spacetime be engineered in the lab? NSF-funded research using high-energy electromagnetic fields and interferometry explores measurable spacetime effects. Includes insights from collaborations with NASA and SpaceX on next-generation propulsion concepts.

events.title: Whoa! This is Nothing Like D&D!
events.description: If you've ever introduced your friends to a new TTRPG, chances are you've heard the phrase 'Is it like D&D?' So let's talk about games that are NOT Dungeons & Dragons, whether they be similar or completely different. We'll talk about why we like them, and why you should play them. Additional Panelists: Abby Plemmons(Moderator)

events.title: Witchy Comics: Magic in Comics
events.description: They can put a spell on you! We discuss the use of magic in comic books, as well as the supernatural elements that really grab a reader and don't let go. Additional Panelists: Jami Jones(Moderator)

events.title: Terrible Beauty: The Fae in Urban Fantasy
events.description: The Fae in Urban Fantasy typically have a significant impact upon the human world they interact with, & often mask an underlying layer of menace and peril. Our panel of authors will discuss the portrayals in their work and the role those characters have within the stories as a whole. Additional Panelists: Carol Malcolm(Moderator)

events.title: The Art of the Hoax
events.description: We'll examine a few classical hoaxes through an artist's eye as we learn the origins of the Jackalope, the Cottingley fairies, and Georgie the lake monster. Pranking has been a beloved pastime for centuries, & these artful tricksters have hoodwinked plenty who thought themselves too smart to fool.

events.title: The Boys Guests: Supes, Scandals & Stories
events.description: With the story now complete, there's plenty to look back on. From characters who changed along the way to the moments that surprised everyone, this is a chance to hear what the experience was like from the people who brought this very bloody, very strange world to life.

events.title: The Enchanted Disney Tiki Pop Art Connection
events.description: In 1963, Walt Disney introduced a Tropical Serenade to the masses – and they've been producing variations on this theme ever since, including the most recent release of Moana. Join us as we discuss the influence of Disney on Pop Artists – and 'vice versa.' Additional Panelists: Justin Peterson

events.title: The Gilded Age: Looking at the American Victorian Era *Spoiler Warning*
events.description: As we await HBO's Gilded Age Season 4, we know that we aren't done with the plotting and maneuvering of the families in New York society. We'll gather to chat about our favorite moments, our favorite characters, and what we hope to see in the next season. Additional Panelists: Emily Myerscough(Moderator)

events.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly: 60th Anniversary Retrospective
events.description: 60 years on, is the world still divided between those who dig and those who have a gun? Our fan panel discusses the movie itself and its continuing influence on the modern Western as a film in general. Additional Panelists: Andrew Hartley(Moderator)

events.title: The Humanity of Monsters: Writing Creatures We Care about
events.description: Does an inhuman creature deserve love? What drives their actions? Do they have souls? Our panel of authors will discuss how to craft monsters that blur the lines between sympathetic and horrific, love and hate, and peace and mayhem. Additional Panelists: Karen Bembry(Moderator)

events.title: The Investigation vs. the Edit: Paranormal TV Debated
events.description: Paranormal reality TV is everywhere – but is it helping or hurting the field? Additional Panelists: Aaron LeGood(Moderator), Rebecca Carlson

events.title: The Post?Apocalypse Writer's Wasteland
events.description: Authors of ruined worlds gather to share readings, inspirations, and survival?themed storytelling. events.title: The Scottish Play: An Analysis of Macbeth
events.description: Explore how Macbeth's themes of ambition, guilt, and power resonate across modern film, TV, literature, and theater. Additional Panelists: Bill Hussar, Caro McCully(Moderator), Mark Heffernan, Trey Lawson
